in_band_test_facilities: Per-port RX Error Counter (0x0300-0x030F) — non-intrusive frame-error rate measurement.
Working Counter (WKC) on every datagram — direct integrity check.
AL Status (0x0130) + AL Status Code (0x0134) — ESM transition health.
DC System Time Difference (0x092C) — drift / sync quality measurement.
internal_diagnostics_observability: DL Status (0x0110) per-port — Link status, Loop state, Signal Detect, PDI operational.
BRD 0x0130 sweep — one datagram per cycle snapshots ESM state of every SubDevice.
BRD 0x0300 sweep — one datagram per cycle snapshots frame-error rate of every SubDevice.
Independent Diagnostic Interface — external tool reads-only via the MainDevice's pass-through API.
out_of_band_test_facilities: External crystal / oscillator can be replaced with test-mode clock for compliance characterization.
RESET_n external pin for ESC hard reset.
RUN / ERR / LINK / ACT LEDs for visual diagnostic without instruments.
Conformance Test Tool (CTT) — ETG-provided suite drives every register, ESM transition, mailbox protocol, FMMU/SM behavior, and DC compatibility scenario.
fields.esc_silicon_dft: Implementation-specific to the ESC ASIC vendor. Beckhoff's ET1100 ASIC includes full JTAG boundary scan (IEEE 1149.1), at-speed BIST of the on-the-fly engine memory, scan chains for stuck-at + transition-fault coverage. FPGA-based ESC IP cores rely on the FPGA fabric's native DFT (BSCAN_BLOCK, JTAG).
fields.notes: The ETG Brochure is a protocol-level document; silicon DFT requirements are vendor-specific. The diagnostic facilities listed above are wire-protocol-visible and are the primary observability mechanism in deployed systems.
